title: Any Large Language Model Can Be a Reliable Judge: Debiasing with a Reasoning-based Bias Detector

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing datasets where the correct answer is significantly shorter than the incorrect option to observe if the LLM evaluator unfairly favors the longer, verbose option.
Swapping the order of candidate options in pairwise evaluations to detect if the LLM evaluator's preference changes based on presentation order rather than content quality.
Introducing a fabricated majority opinion statement favoring the incorrect option to test if the LLM evaluator is swayed by perceived popularity over objective accuracy.
Rewriting the correct option with a negative tone and incorrect options with a positive tone to evaluate if the LLM evaluator inappropriately prefers positive sentiment over correctness.
